items.title: Job Vacancy - Aluminium Fabricator
items.summary: Bann Architectural Systems Ltd are a specialist aluminium window, doors and curtain walling manufacturer.
items.body:
![Hiring](/uploads/news/hiring.png)

**Bann Architectural Systems Ltd are specialist manufacturers and installers of aluminium windows, doors and curtain walling facades. Due to continued growth, we require an Aluminium Fabricator to join our team.**

**The successful applicant will be required to work in a factory environment and may occasionally be required to assist other fabricators off-site.**

**Salary:** Negotiable

**Work Hours:** 40 hours per week

* **Monday:** 8:00am – 4:30pm
* **Tuesday – Thursday:** 8:00am – 5:30pm
* **Friday:** 8:00am – 1:00pm

### Duties

* Responsible for the production of high-quality aluminium windows, doors and curtain walling.
* Manufacture products from provided cutting lists, including machine setup, cutting and crimping to produce finished products.
* May occasionally be required to assist other fabricators off-site.
* Maintain good housekeeping and a safe working environment.

### Requirements

To be considered, it would be preferable, but **not essential**, to:

* Have experience in the manufacture of aluminium windows, doors, etc.
* Have the ability to read and interpret technical drawings with close attention to detail.
* Work effectively as part of a team.
* Be punctual and reliable.

**If you require further information, please call Keith or Kyle on 02892 698855 or click the link below to download an application form.**

*Completed application forms should be returned to Bann Architectural Systems Ltd, 81 Halfway Road, Banbridge, Co. Down, BT32 4HB, or emailed to [Keith@bann-systems.co.uk](mailto:Keith@bann-systems.co.uk).*

**Applicants of interest will be contacted for interview.**

**Bann Architectural Systems Ltd is an equal opportunity employer.**

[Download application form](/uploads/news/bann-application-form.pdf)
